Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Senior Associate Cross Technology Technical Services (TS) Systems Integration Specialist is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for ensuring that client solution requirements are resolved in line with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).  
  
This role performs configurations, actions installations and attends to break/fix events and works towards associate to professional level certification, whilst at the same time developing business knowledge.

* Demonstrate. relevant domain specialist knowledge.
* Good verbal communication skills.
* Client focused and display a proactive approach to solving problems.

description:
**Job Summary**

The Agent Tool Integration Engineer will design and optimize integrations across ServiceNow ITSM and Zenoss platforms to support hybrid operations for a multinational environment. The role focuses on building reliable monitoring and workflow solutions that improve service quality enhance incident visibility and streamline Finance and Accounting processes through robust automation and observability.

* Optimize alerting rules in Zenoss to reduce noise and ensure that only actionable and prioritized events are routed into ServiceNow ITSM queues
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to understand integration requirements and translate them into stable technical solutions using ServiceNow and Zenoss capabilities
* Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for integration designs configuration baselines runbooks and operational procedures to support ongoing maintenance
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues across ServiceNow ITSM Zenoss Cloud and Zenoss deployments while minimizing impact on business services
* Implement robust data validation and transformation logic to ensure that events configuration items and service data are consistently synchronized between platforms
* Enhance automation workflows to support Finance and Accounting processes by enabling faster incident resolution and improved service reporting for financial systems
* Perform impact analysis and regression testing for integration changes to safeguard production environments and maintain high platform reliability in the hybrid work model
* Coordinate with security and compliance stakeholders to ensure that integration configurations adhere to enterprise governance policies and audit requirements
* Mentor junior team members on best practices in tool integration event management and configuration management to strengthen overall team capability
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve monitoring coverage workflow efficiency and user experience through incremental enhancements in ServiceNow ITSM and Zenoss solutions

**Qualifications**

* Apply professional experience of six to ten years in enterprise tool integration with a primary focus on ServiceNow ITSM and large scale monitoring platforms
* Demonstrate hands on expertise in configuring ServiceNow ITSM processes including incident problem change and request management to support global operations
* Utilize advanced knowledge of Zenoss Cloud to design service models configure event classes and build dashboards tailored to critical infrastructure components
* Leverage practical experience with Zenoss to implement reliable monitoring of applications databases and network elements with accurate thresholds and event lifecycles
* Employ understanding of Finance and Accounting domain processes as a valuable asset to tailor monitoring and incident workflows for financial applications and related services
* Operate efficiently within a hybrid work model by using collaboration tools clear documentation and structured handover practices to coordinate with distributed teams
* Communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders to explain integration changes articulate risks and propose mitigation options that protect business outcomes

**Certifications Required**

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and ITSM Implementation Specialist or equivalent monitoring platform certification
